title: Alex의 여행, 숙소, 이동과 선물 계획

messages.content: 요즘 여행 준비하는 재미로 지내요. 이번 목적지는 Bayport인데, 사진만 봐도 빨리 가고 싶어요.
Having a trip to look forward to is exciting! How long will you be away?
Four nights. I do not want to pack every day with plans, though. I did that last time and came home exhausted.
A little breathing room sounds nice. Where did you go last time?
지난 여행은 Hillhaven으로 갔어요. 좋은 곳이었는데 너무 많이 걸어서 숙소에 오면 바로 잠들었어요.
Sounds like your feet needed a holiday afterward! Where did you stay in Hillhaven?
I stayed at Cedar Inn in Hillhaven. It was small and quiet, which was exactly what I needed at night.
A quiet place to come back to makes a difference. Have you booked somewhere in Bayport yet?
네, Bayport 숙소는 Lantern Hotel로 예약했어요. 객실 사진이 마음에 들었고 조식도 있더라고요.
Breakfast on site could save you a little planning. What time does Lantern Hotel start serving it?
Breakfast at Lantern Hotel starts at 7:30 a.m. That should suit me, unless I decide to sleep in.
Nice to have the option! What about the journey there? Which airport are you flying into?
도착 공항은 Eastgate Airport예요. 비행기 내리고 나서 이동하는 게 제일 긴장돼요.
That first bit can feel overwhelming. Have you looked up the shuttle from Eastgate Airport?
Yes, the shuttle from Eastgate Airport is route L4. I saved the route, but I still need to check the stops.
You're making a good start. We can go through the next part of the journey when you're ready.
셔틀 노선을 마저 봤어요. L4의 종점이 Garden Square더라고요. 도착하면 잠깐 앉아서 숨 좀 돌리고 싶어요.
A breather after the journey sounds good. Are you taking a big suitcase?
No, I will take my blue backpack. I want to travel light, especially if I need to carry it around before check-in.
Your shoulders will probably thank you. Are you meeting anyone during the trip?
네, 이번 여행에서 친구 Iris를 만나기로 했어요. 한동안 못 봐서 같이 밥 먹으면서 얘기하려고요.
That'll be a lovely chance to catch up. Has Iris suggested a restaurant?
Iris chose Saffron Table. I have been looking at the menu, and now I want to order far too much.
Menus have a way of doing that! Is there a vegetarian dish that stands out?
Saffron Table의 대표 채식 메뉴가 구운 단호박 커리래요. 맛있어 보여서 먹어보고 싶어요.
That does sound tasty. Is there anything you'll need to ask the staff about before ordering?
I have a peanut allergy, so I need to avoid peanuts. I will ask about ingredients instead of guessing from the menu.
Checking with the staff sounds sensible. Have you got any other restaurant suggestions to look at?
Noah는 Copper Spoon을 추천해 줬어요. 시간 되면 메뉴를 더 봐야겠지만, 매끼 외식하면 돈이 꽤 들겠죠?
Food costs can add up. Have you set yourself a budget for the trip?
My budget is 600 US dollars, excluding flights. I want some room for a small gift, so I will keep track as I go.
Leaving room for a gift sounds thoughtful. We can talk through the rest of your plans next time.
일기예보에 비 표시가 있어서 실내 활동도 하나 골랐어요. 비 오는 날에는 도자기 페인팅 워크숍에 가려고요.
That sounds like a fun way to spend a rainy afternoon. Where is the workshop held?
The ceramic painting workshop is at Moon Kiln. I like the idea of making something instead of just buying it.
Making something yourself could be a nice memory. Have you booked a time at Moon Kiln?
Moon Kiln은 수요일 오후 6시로 예약했어요. 그 시간 전에는 날씨를 보면서 움직이려고요.
That leaves you some flexibility earlier in the day. What would you do if it stayed dry?
If it is dry, I want to walk along the canal in the old town. I might browse a few shops on the way, too.
A slow walk with a few stops sounds lovely. Who were you thinking of buying a souvenir for?
이번 여행 선물은 아버지 Daniel께 드리려고요. 흔한 기념품보다는 좋아하시는 걸 찾아보고 싶어요.
That's thoughtful. What does Daniel like to collect?
Daniel collects wooden bird ornaments. He has a little shelf for them, and he always notices when I move one.
Ha, he clearly knows his collection well! Have you found a shop selling wooden birds?
나무 새 장식품은 Willow Crafts에서 사기로 했어요. 이제 가게까지 길을 잘 찾아가기만 하면 돼요.
Having the shop picked out is a good start. What would help you feel more comfortable finding your way?
Before the trip, I want to practice asking for directions and understanding the answers. I freeze when someone talks too fast.
We can practice at a comfortable pace. You could start by asking me how to get to a shop.
